title: Early software
summary: This is a working prototype, not a finished product. Expect some rough edges.
paragraphs: My Own Suite is early software. It works — we run it ourselves — but it hasn't yet been hardened by years of production use, and some features have had limited real-world testing.

We're also open about how it's built: many modules were written partly or mostly with AI assistance. Human engineers set the architecture, direct the work, and review the critical paths — but not every line has been hand-audited yet.
If the project proves its worth and graduates to a real alpha, every module will go through full verification by human software engineers before we call it that.
callout: Practical advice for now: keep backups (MOS makes that easy), and don't make this the only copy of anything you'd hate to lose.
